meta.title: SwarmAI Commercial Studio (Spotlight) — business-case assumptions
conventions: Scenarios: only the key value drivers listed in 'scenario_drivers' (plus the partner-pipeline counts) move, and they move HALF-WAY (scenario_blend = 0.5) from 'base' towards their unfavourable (Conservative) or favourable (Upside) bound. Every other assumption stays at base in all scenarios and is explored one at a time in the tornado with its full low/high bounds. Stacking every bound at once would be a worst/best case, not a scenario.

Expansion levers E1-E4 (generative video, catalog-scale content, audience-level personalization, marketing data platform) are optional Release-2+ options with their own cost AND benefit. Their lever scales (e1_scale ... e4_scale, 0 = off, 1 = full scale by Year 3) are on/off decisions, so they carry an entry-level 'blend' of 1.0: Conservative and Base = 0 (Release-1 scope only, numbers unchanged), Upside = 1.
Year 0 = implementation (one-time spend, no benefit); Years 1-3 = operation. Cash flows are annual, end-of-year discounting, Year 0 undiscounted.
flag: 'brief' = given in the engagement brief; 'sourced' = public source cited in 'sources'; 'assumption' = judgement with rationale - validate with customer data before relying on it.

favourable: which end of the range improves customer ROI ('high' / 'low'); 'neutral' = the value is the same in all scenarios (explored only in the tornado). Conservative picks the unfavourable end, Upside the favourable end, Base uses 'base'.

All Azure costs are list prices from the Azure Retail Prices API (pay-as-you-go, USD, no EA/MACC discount, no reservations) multiplied by explicit unit-consumption assumptions; Azure run cost in the ROI equals the ACR of the same scenario.

Benefits are credited only for work the customer would otherwise have bought (displaced baseline work) plus measurable performance uplift; extra versions produced beyond today's volume earn no avoided-agency-cost credit.
Every benefit line is multiplied by a confidence factor; every Studio cost is charged at full volume (no credit for avoided internal review hours).

customer.name: Contoso Consumer Brands
customer.description: Fictional global CPG / retail group: US$8 B revenue, marketing spend about 8 % of revenue, 12 markets, about 5,000 creative assets per year today (target 50,000 versions with personalisation), 6-10 week brief-to-asset cycle time. Northwind Coffee Roasters ('Dawn Roast') is a brand in its portfolio.

revenue_usd.label: Annual revenue
revenue_usd.rationale: Reference customer profile from the engagement brief.

marketing_pct_revenue.label: Marketing spend as % of revenue
marketing_pct_revenue.rationale: Brief states about 8 %; Gartner's 2026 survey of large enterprises reports an average of 7.8 % of revenue.

paid_media_pct_marketing.label: Paid media share of the marketing budget
paid_media_pct_marketing.rationale: Gartner 2026 CMO Spend Survey: paid media 31.4 % of marketing budgets (30.6 % in 2025).

media_scope_pct_paid.label: Share of paid media where creative variants are tested and optimised (in scope)
media_scope_pct_paid.rationale: Digital video, social, CTV and retail-media placements accept many creative variants; linear TV, OOH, print and radio do not. Gartner reports digital is more than two-thirds of media investment; 35 % of paid media is deliberately conservative.

baseline_assets_per_year.label: Creative assets produced per year today
baseline_assets_per_year.rationale: Brief: about 5,000 creative assets per year today.

annual_asset_volume.label: Approved asset versions per year at full adoption
annual_asset_volume.rationale: Brief: target 50,000 versions with personalisation (10x today's volume at a flat budget; Adobe's 2025 survey finds 71 % of marketers expect content demand to grow 5x or more by 2027).

versions_per_campaign.label: Approved versions per campaign (average)
versions_per_campaign.rationale: A campaign = hero master + cut-downs x formats x languages x variants; about 250 campaigns a year at 50,000 versions.

active_users_full.label: Active Studio users at full adoption
active_users_full.rationale: Brand, creative, performance, legal and regional marketers across 12 markets; interactive co-creation drives model usage.

min_active_users.label: Minimum active users in any operating year

variants_per_campaign.label: Creative variants tested per campaign
variants_per_campaign.rationale: Brief/demo: 12 variants ranked by the pre-flight scorecard (3 hooks x 2 CTAs x 2 visuals).

ref_variants_per_campaign.label: Reference variant count at which roas_uplift_pct is defined
ref_variants_per_campaign.rationale: Uplift scales with ln(1+variants) relative to this reference (diminishing returns).

adoption_y1.label: Adoption, Year 1 (share of full-adoption volume)
adoption_y1.rationale: Pilot in months 0-6 (one brand, 2-3 markets), one brand live in months 6-12.

adoption_y2.label: Adoption, Year 2
adoption_y2.rationale: Portfolio roll-out to 3-5 brands and 8 markets.

adoption_y3.label: Adoption, Year 3
adoption_y3.rationale: All brands and 12 markets; 85 % of full-adoption volume is deliberately below 100 %.

mix_baseline_hero_spot.label: Baseline asset mix - hero spots
mix_baseline_hero_spot.rationale: About 30 hero films a year in 5,000 assets.

mix_baseline_adapted_video.label: Baseline asset mix - adapted video
mix_baseline_adapted_video.rationale: Formats, cut-downs and variants of hero films and digital-first video.

mix_baseline_static_social.label: Baseline asset mix - static & social images
mix_baseline_static_social.rationale: Display, social tiles, retail and e-commerce images.

mix_baseline_copy_crm.label: Baseline asset mix - copy & CRM
mix_baseline_copy_crm.rationale: Headlines, captions, emails, push, retail-media copy. The four baseline shares sum to 1.0.

mix_studio_hero_spot.label: Studio asset mix - hero / AI-native masters
mix_studio_hero_spot.rationale: About 150 masters a year at 50,000 versions (5x today because masters get cheaper).

mix_studio_adapted_video.label: Studio asset mix - adapted video
mix_studio_adapted_video.rationale: Versions per master x formats x languages x variants.

mix_studio_copy_crm.label: Studio asset mix - copy & CRM
mix_studio_copy_crm.rationale: The four Studio shares sum to 1.0.

baseline_cost_hero_spot.label: Agency + production cost per 30 s hero spot (first pass)
baseline_cost_hero_spot.rationale: Brief: agency + production cost per 30 s spot is a business-case anchor; replace with Contoso PO / invoice data in the first week of the pilot.

baseline_cost_adapted_video.label: Agency + production cost per adapted video asset (first pass)
baseline_cost_adapted_video.rationale: Re-editing, re-versioning and finishing of a master per format/length/language; replace with invoices. Offshore adaptation benchmarks report 40-60 % savings versus onshore rates (Amnet/IHAF 2025), i.e. adaptation is a large, addressable cost pool.

baseline_cost_static_social.label: Agency + production cost per static / social image (first pass)
baseline_cost_static_social.rationale: Retouching, resizing and legal-super application per static unit; replace with invoices.

baseline_cost_copy_crm.label: Agency + production cost per copy / CRM asset (first pass)
baseline_cost_copy_crm.rationale: Copy writing, adaptation and proofing per asset.

addressable_hero_spot.label: Share of hero-spot cost Studio can displace
addressable_hero_spot.rationale: Live-action shoots stay with agencies; Studio displaces concepting, scripting, animatics, versions and AI-native digital masters.

addressable_adapted_video.label: Share of adapted-video cost Studio can displace
addressable_adapted_video.rationale: Reformat, cut-down, caption, localise and variant work is automatable; talent, final polish and rights stay external.

addressable_static_social.label: Share of static / social cost Studio can displace
addressable_static_social.rationale: Generation, resizing and layout are automatable; brand and legal review remain.

addressable_copy_crm.label: Share of copy / CRM cost Studio can displace
addressable_copy_crm.rationale: Text work is the most automatable.

review_min_hero_spot.label: Human review minutes per hero master (all gates, all reviewers)
review_min_hero_spot.rationale: About 15 hours across brand, creative director, legal and regional reviewers.

review_min_adapted_video.label: Human review minutes per adapted video version
review_min_adapted_video.rationale: Review by exception once the master and rules are approved; Guardian pre-screens every version.

review_min_static_social.label: Human review minutes per static / social version

review_min_copy_crm.label: Human review minutes per copy / CRM version

guardian_scale_hero_spot.label: Guardian token scale - hero master
guardian_scale_hero_spot.rationale: Longer scripts, more frames and more rules.

adapt_in_k_hero_spot.label: Adaptation tokens in (K) per hero master beyond campaign-level work
adapt_in_k_hero_spot.rationale: Timeline spec, shot-by-shot prompt writing, caption and super drafting.

adapt_out_k_hero_spot.label: Adaptation tokens out (K) per hero master (incl. reasoning)

adapt_in_k_adapted_video.label: Adaptation tokens in (K) per adapted video version
adapt_in_k_adapted_video.rationale: Derive the timeline spec for a format/cut-down/variant from the master, with brand context.

adapt_out_k_adapted_video.label: Adaptation tokens out (K) per adapted video version
adapt_out_k_adapted_video.rationale: Spec + copy tweaks, incl. reasoning tokens.

adapt_in_k_static_social.label: Adaptation tokens in (K) per static / social version
adapt_in_k_static_social.rationale: Layout prompt with brand rules and claim set.

adapt_out_k_static_social.label: Adaptation tokens out (K) per static / social version

adapt_in_k_copy_crm.label: Adaptation tokens in (K) per copy / CRM version

adapt_out_k_copy_crm.label: Adaptation tokens out (K) per copy / CRM version

agency_fee_pct_of_production.label: Agency fees billed on top of third-party production
agency_fee_pct_of_production.rationale: Creative, account and project-management fees for adaptation, versioning and trafficking; replace with agency rate cards.

agency_fee_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of agency fees on the displaced work
agency_fee_reduction_pct.rationale: Hours shift from execution to oversight; Gartner's 2026 survey notes CMOs are already shifting spend from agencies to paid media. Mondelez reports a 30-50 % cut in content production cost.

loc_share_per_market.label: Localised share of versions added per additional market
loc_share_per_market.rationale: Localised share = min(cap, this x (markets - 1)); 12 markets gives about 40 % of versions localised.

loc_share_cap.label: Maximum localised share of versions
loc_share_cap.rationale: Some assets are global and need no localisation.

baseline_localization_depth.label: Depth of localisation today relative to Studio (baseline localises less because it is costly)
baseline_localization_depth.rationale: Cost-constrained teams localise fewer assets than they would like.

cost_per_localized_version_usd.label: Incremental cost per localised version today (transcreation, VO, subtitles, QA, re-versioning)
cost_per_localized_version_usd.rationale: Incremental language work on top of the production cost; replace with LSP/agency invoices.

localization_cost_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of localisation cost with Studio (human linguist QA retained)
localization_cost_reduction_pct.rationale: Transcreation, VO and captions are automated; linguist QA remains and is charged on the Studio side.

time_critical_campaigns_per_year.label: Time-critical campaigns per year (launches, seasonal, promotions)
time_critical_campaigns_per_year.rationale: Campaigns where in-market timing drives sales.

weeks_saved.label: Weeks of cycle time saved on time-critical campaigns
weeks_saved.rationale: Brief: 6-10 week cycle time today; Studio targets about 2-4 weeks including human gates (KPI-02), i.e. 4-6 weeks saved; the base case credits 4 weeks.

incremental_gp_per_week_usd.label: Incremental gross profit per additional in-market week per campaign
incremental_gp_per_week_usd.rationale: Weekly incremental gross profit attributable to a campaign (not total sales).

speed_realisation_pct.label: Share of saved weeks that become additional selling weeks (rest only shifts timing)
speed_realisation_pct.rationale: CFOs discount speed benefits heavily; most launches shift rather than add demand.

baseline_roas.label: Baseline ROAS on in-scope media (revenue per US$ of media)
baseline_roas.rationale: Blended short-term return on digital media for CPG; replace with Contoso MMM / platform data.

roas_uplift_pct.label: ROAS uplift from creative testing at the reference variant count and full coverage
roas_uplift_pct.rationale: Conservative versus vendor-published creative-testing claims; Nielsen/NCSolutions reports creative as the largest single advertising driver of sales contribution. Must be proven with a holdout test in the pilot (KPI-05).

contribution_margin_pct.label: Contribution margin on incremental sales
contribution_margin_pct.rationale: Gross margin of about 40 % less variable selling and distribution cost.

volume_for_full_coverage.label: Approved versions per year needed to cover all in-scope media with the reference variant count
volume_for_full_coverage.rationale: Coverage = min(1, volume / this); more volume than needed earns no extra uplift.

incidents_per_year.label: Marketing compliance incidents reaching market per year (claims, rights, disclosure)
incidents_per_year.rationale: Takedowns, corrections and regulator letters; replace with the legal register. The EU found 53.3 % of examined environmental claims vague, misleading or unfounded (2020 study).

avg_incident_cost_usd.label: Average cost per incident (legal, re-production, withdrawn media, response)

incident_reduction_pct.label: Routine incidents avoided with Guardian + gates
incident_reduction_pct.rationale: Claims, rights and disclosure checks are rule-based and automatable; novel issues still need people.

severe_event_prob.label: Annual probability of a severe brand / regulatory event linked to creative

severe_reduction_pct.label: Severe-event probability reduction
severe_reduction_pct.rationale: Guardian addresses a minority of tail causes.

rework_pct_of_first_pass.label: Rework cost as % of first-pass production + fees
rework_pct_of_first_pass.rationale: Revision rounds from unclear briefs and late legal findings.

rework_reduction_pct.label: Rework avoided (clear briefs, early Guardian checks)
rework_reduction_pct.rationale: Briefing agent completeness check plus Guardian at every gate.

media_waste_pct.label: In-scope media wasted on defective or withdrawn creative
media_waste_pct.rationale: Pause/relaunch, spec mismatches, rights lapses. Distinct from ROAS uplift (which is about better creative, not defective creative).

media_waste_reduction_pct.label: Defect-driven media waste avoided
media_waste_reduction_pct.rationale: Pre-flight checks and rights expiry alerts.

confidence_production.label: Confidence factor - production & adaptation
confidence_production.rationale: Measurable from invoices and the live cost meter.

confidence_agency.label: Confidence factor - agency fees
confidence_agency.rationale: Depends on renegotiating scopes and retainers.

confidence_roas.label: Confidence factor - ROAS uplift
confidence_roas.rationale: Attribution uncertainty; validate with a holdout.

confidence_rework.label: Confidence factor - rework & media waste
confidence_rework.rationale: Revision rounds are measurable in the approval workflow.

platform_licence_usd_per_year.label: Studio platform licence & support at full scale
platform_licence_usd_per_year.rationale: Illustrative commercial terms for the solution (partner IP + support); not a Microsoft price.

implementation_usd.label: One-time implementation & integration (DAM, ad platforms, Teams, Entra, Brand Brain onboarding, security review)

impl_share_y0.label: Share of implementation spent in Year 0

integration_run_pct.label: Integration run & maintenance as % of implementation per year
integration_run_pct.rationale: Connector upkeep, API changes, rule updates; half in Year 1.

change_share_y0.label: Share of one-time change cost in Year 0

change_run_usd_per_year.label: Ongoing change management (champions, governance board, refresh training)

rights_library_usd_per_year.label: Licensed music / stock library fees attributable to Studio
rights_library_usd_per_year.rationale: Counted in full although the customer already licenses music and stock today.

reviewer_rate_usd_per_hour.label: Loaded hourly cost of brand / creative / legal reviewers

localized_review_minutes.label: Linguist QA minutes per localised version
localized_review_minutes.rationale: Back-translation check flags drift; linguists review flagged and sampled items.

exception_rate.label: Share of versions escalated to a human by the Guardian
exception_rate.rationale: Auto-revise converges for most; the rest escalate.

discount_rate.label: Discount rate
discount_rate.rationale: Typical corporate hurdle rate; replace with Contoso WACC.

azure_consumption_scale.label: Multiplier on all Azure unit-consumption assumptions
azure_consumption_scale.rationale: Calibrate with the live cost meter (CS-15): measured tokens, images and seconds per approved asset replace the assumptions below.

ai_price_uplift_pct.label: Model price uplift versus Global Standard list
ai_price_uplift_pct.rationale: The Retail Prices API lists EU Data Zone Standard 10 % above Global Standard (e.g. gpt-5.4-mini input $0.825 vs $0.75 per 1M tokens) and Regional about 21 % above. Base assumes an EU data-zone deployment for a 12-market customer; the demo slice uses Global Standard.

cached_input_share.label: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache
cached_input_share.rationale: Brand context and rules repeat across calls; cached input is priced at 10 % of input.

calls_per_interaction.label: Model calls per user action in the agentic workspace (plan, retrieve + draft, critique)
calls_per_interaction.rationale: A user action triggers a short agent run rather than a single completion; to be measured with the live meter (CS-15).

camp_brief_in_k.label: Briefing agent tokens in per campaign

camp_brief_out_k.label: Briefing agent tokens out per campaign

camp_strategy_in_k.label: Strategy agent tokens in per campaign (reasoning model)
camp_strategy_in_k.rationale: Two passes with Brand Brain and learnings.

camp_strategy_out_k.label: Strategy agent tokens out per campaign (incl. reasoning)

camp_script_in_k.label: Script & copy agent tokens in per campaign
camp_script_in_k.rationale: 6/15/30/60 s scripts, channel copy, tone variants, one targeted revision.

camp_script_out_k.label: Script & copy agent tokens out per campaign

camp_story_in_k.label: Storyboard agent tokens in per campaign
camp_story_in_k.rationale: Shot list and frame prompts with the style bible.

camp_story_out_k.label: Storyboard agent tokens out per campaign

camp_guardian_stage_in_k.label: Guardian tokens in per stage gate per campaign
camp_guardian_stage_in_k.rationale: Stage-level review of the concept, script and storyboard.

camp_guardian_stage_out_k.label: Guardian tokens out per stage gate per campaign

camp_preflight_in_k_per_variant.label: Pre-flight panel tokens in per variant
camp_preflight_in_k_per_variant.rationale: Five persona prompts of about 3K tokens each.

camp_preflight_out_k_per_variant.label: Pre-flight panel tokens out per variant

camp_insights_in_k.label: Insight generation tokens in per campaign (reasoning model)
camp_insights_in_k.rationale: Four weekly analyses over performance tables.

camp_insights_out_k.label: Insight generation tokens out per campaign
camp_insights_out_k.rationale: Insights written back to the Brand Brain.

camp_images_medium.label: Storyboard / concept images per campaign (medium quality, 1536x1024, incl. regenerations)

ver_guardian_in_k.label: Guardian tokens in per check (rules, claims for the market, brand voice, frames)
ver_guardian_in_k.rationale: Retrieval-grounded checks carry the market claim set and brand rules.

ver_guardian_out_k.label: Guardian tokens out per check (incl. reasoning)

guardian_loop_factor.label: Auto-revise loop factor on Guardian and revision calls
guardian_loop_factor.rationale: Brief: auto-revise converges in at most 3 iterations; most pass first time.

guardian_reasoning_share.label: Share of Guardian checks run on the reasoning model (regulated categories)
guardian_reasoning_share.rationale: Food, beverage, alcohol, finance and health categories use the higher-accuracy model.

recheck_share_live.label: Share of the year's versions that are live and re-checked when rules change
recheck_share_live.rationale: Continuous compliance when claims, rights or regulations change.

rechecks_per_year.label: Portfolio re-scans per year
rechecks_per_year.rationale: Claims-library and regulatory updates (e.g. EU Directive 2024/825 from 27 Sep 2026).

loc_in_k.label: Localisation tokens in per localised version (transcreation + back-translation)
loc_in_k.rationale: Scripts, supers, glossary and a back-translation check.

loc_out_k.label: Localisation tokens out per localised version

ver_images_adapted_video.label: New key-frames per adapted video version
ver_images_adapted_video.rationale: Variants with a new visual need a new key-frame; most reuse master frames.

ver_images_static.label: New images per static / social version

image_attempt_factor.label: Generation attempts per accepted image
image_attempt_factor.rationale: Regeneration after review or Guardian findings.

img_tokens_medium_1536.label: Output image tokens, medium quality, 1536x1024
img_tokens_medium_1536.rationale: Published GPT-image output-token counts per image (medium, landscape/portrait); reproduces per-image list prices at the Retail API output-token price ($32 per 1M).

img_prompt_text_tokens.label: Text prompt tokens per image request

img_ref_image_tokens.label: Reference-image input tokens per image request that uses a reference

img_ref_share.label: Share of image requests that use a reference image

interactions_per_user_day.label: AI interactions per active user per working day
interactions_per_user_day.rationale: Co-creation in the workspace (rewrite, refine, check, translate, ask the Brand Brain).

interaction_in_k.label: Tokens in per interaction (retrieval-grounded context)
interaction_in_k.rationale: Brand guidance, claims and prior versions in context.

interactive_reasoning_share.label: Share of interactions on the reasoning model

images_per_user_day.label: Interactive images generated per user per day (medium, 1024x1024)

cs_text_records_per_version.label: Content Safety text records per version (1 record = up to 1,000 characters)

cs_images_per_video_version.label: Content Safety images per video version (sampled frames)
cs_images_per_video_version.rationale: Frame sampling of the rendered spot.

cs_images_per_static_version.label: Content Safety images per static version (final check)

cs_records_per_interaction.label: Content Safety text records per interactive exchange

tts_share_of_video_versions.label: Share of video versions that need a fresh voice-over

tts_chars_per_video_version.label: Voice-over characters per video version
tts_chars_per_video_version.rationale: A 15 s spot is about 40 words.

tts_hd_share.label: Share of synthesised speech on tts-hd (rest on Azure AI Speech neural voices)
tts_hd_share.rationale: Premium voices for hero and English; neural voices for bulk localisation.

translator_chars_per_loc_version.label: Azure AI Translator characters per localised version (glossary-constrained MT for captions and supers)
translator_chars_per_loc_version.rationale: Deterministic terminology pass next to the LLM.

render_vcpu_s_per_output_s.label: vCPU-seconds per rendered second (ffmpeg compositor, 1080p H.264)
render_vcpu_s_per_output_s.rationale: Zoompan, overlays, captions, two-pass loudness; to be measured in the reference implementation.

render_master_vcpu_s.label: Extra render vCPU-seconds per hero master

render_gib_per_vcpu.label: Memory GiB per vCPU in render jobs

aca_active_share.label: Share of time app-tier replicas are billed at active rates (rest idle)

mb_per_video_version.label: Delivered file size per video version
mb_per_video_version.rationale: 1080p H.264 at about 6 Mbit/s for 15 s.

mb_per_static_version.label: Delivered file size per static version

storage_working_files_factor.label: Working files (key-frames, stems, intermediates, manifests) as multiple of deliverables

downloads_per_version.label: Downloads / streams from the Studio CDN per approved version
downloads_per_version.rationale: Reviewers, agency, ad-platform upload; ad delivery itself runs on the ad platforms.

events_per_version.label: Pipeline events per version (stage transitions, jobs, notifications)

cosmos_kb_per_version.label: Cosmos DB storage per version (documents, versions, audit chain)

search_queries_per_interaction.label: AI Search queries per interactive exchange

search_queries_per_version.label: AI Search queries per version (grounding, DAM search)

semantic_ranker_share.label: Share of queries that use the semantic ranker
semantic_ranker_share.rationale: Brand Brain and DAM natural-language search.

fabric_hours_share.label: Share of hours the Fabric capacity runs (pause outside business and batch windows)
fabric_hours_share.rationale: Pay-as-you-go capacity that can be paused.

attach_dam_hot_share.label: Share of migrated DAM archive kept in the hot tier
attach_dam_hot_share.rationale: Most legacy assets are rarely accessed.

attach_security_rate.label: Security & network landing-zone pull-through as a share of direct fixed platform cost
attach_security_rate.rationale: Sentinel ingestion, firewall, DDoS and Defender plans the platform requires; explicit ratio rather than a meter build-up.

cohort_ramp_age1.label: Customer ramp - first year of life (share of run-rate)
cohort_ramp_age1.rationale: Consumption builds as brands and markets are added.

tam_target_accounts.label: Target accounts: enterprise marketers with multi-market brand portfolios in consumer-facing sectors
tam_target_accounts.rationale: Directional count (consumer goods, retail, automotive, travel, financial services with at least US$1 B revenue); not sourced - replace with Microsoft account data.

tam_agency_networks.label: Target agency networks / holding companies
tam_agency_networks.rationale: Large agency groups and in-house studios that could run client brands multi-tenant.

tam_share_one_brand.label: Share of target accounts that adopt at one-brand scale (rest at global-portfolio scale)

tam_penetration_mid.label: Penetration of the target accounts at steady state
tam_penetration_mid.rationale: Illustrative mid-term adoption of an AI commercial-studio class of solution; the three-year partner pipeline equals about 1-2 %.

new_pilot_y1.label: New pilot customers, Year 1
new_pilot_y1.rationale: Illustrative partner-led motion; not a forecast.

new_global_portfolio_y1.label: New global-portfolio customers, Year 1
new_global_portfolio_y1.rationale: Enterprise deals follow successful brand deployments.

new_agency_network_y1.label: New agency-network customers, Year 1
new_agency_network_y1.rationale: Multi-tenant mode ships after the single-tenant GA.

new_enterprise_scale_y1.label: New enterprise-scale customers (catalog + generative video + personalization), Year 1
new_enterprise_scale_y1.rationale: Enterprise-scale accounts appear when global-portfolio customers adopt the expansion levers E1-E4 (Release 2+); none in Base, which is Release-1 scope.

new_enterprise_scale_y2.label: New enterprise-scale customers, Year 2
new_enterprise_scale_y2.rationale: Upside only (half-way to high = 1 account): expansion follows a successful global-portfolio deployment.

tam_expansion_share.label: Share of the other global-portfolio accounts that add E1-E4 at the reference customer's own scale
tam_expansion_share.rationale: Directional: not every account has a large catalog, a generative-video use case and CDP data; used only for the TAM-style expansion ceiling.

tam_enterprise_scale_accounts.label: Target accounts at the enterprise-scale profile (large catalog, generative video, personalization)
tam_enterprise_scale_accounts.rationale: Directional count of very large global consumer groups and retailers within the target accounts; not sourced.

e1_scale.label: E1 generative video via VideoProvider - scale reached by the end of Year 3 (0 = off, 1 = full scale)
e1_scale.rationale: 0 = Release-1 scope (Conservative and Base); 1 = the full-scale volumes defined by the e1_* assumptions (Upside). An on/off decision, so scenarios move it fully (blend 1.0). Roadmap R2-01.

e2_scale.label: E2 catalog-scale product content - scale reached by the end of Year 3 (0 = off, 1 = full scale)
e2_scale.rationale: As E1. Roadmap R2-21 (PIM / e-commerce connectors).

e3_scale.label: E3 audience-level personalization - scale reached by the end of Year 3 (0 = off, 1 = full scale)
e3_scale.rationale: As E1. Roadmap R2-02 (personalisation at scale).

e4_scale.label: E4 marketing data and clean-room platform on Fabric - scale reached by the end of Year 3 (0 = off, 1 = full scale)
e4_scale.rationale: As E1. Roadmap R2-08 and R2-22 (Fabric lakehouse, CRM/CDP and clean-room integration).

exp_ramp_y1.label: Expansion levers - share of the Year-3 lever scale reached in Year 1
exp_ramp_y1.rationale: Levers start as pilots on one category or brand after the core studio is live, so Year-1 volumes are small.

exp_ramp_y2.label: Expansion levers - share of the Year-3 lever scale reached in Year 2
exp_ramp_y2.rationale: Roll-out to more categories, markets and audiences once the pilot KPIs are met.

exp_ramp_y3.label: Expansion levers - share of the Year-3 lever scale reached in Year 3
exp_ramp_y3.rationale: By definition the lever scale is the Year-3 level.

exp_fixed_multiplier.label: Dev/test and DR multiplier on expansion fixed infrastructure
exp_fixed_multiplier.rationale: Fabric, Search and Cosmos capacity for the levers needs a small non-production capacity and a backup / DR posture; the core footprints use 1.35-1.70.

exp_integration_share_y1.label: Expansion levers - share of each lever's one-time integration cost incurred in Year 1 (the rest in Year 2)
exp_integration_share_y1.rationale: Year 1 is a pilot at about 10 % of lever scale; most integration effort lands in Year 2 with the roll-out. Integration is charged only for levers whose scale is above zero.

e1_hero_gen_share.label: E1 share of hero masters that include generated footage
e1_hero_gen_share.rationale: Generated shots complement live action (macro pack shots, stylised inserts, set extensions, animatics); live-action shoots remain the norm for hero spots.

e1_hero_gen_seconds.label: E1 kept generated seconds per hero master that uses the lever
e1_hero_gen_seconds.rationale: A 30 s master plus 6/15 s cut-downs assembled from about 40 s of accepted generated shots.

e1_hero_takes.label: E1 generated takes per accepted second (hero)
e1_hero_takes.rationale: Creative direction needs several takes per accepted shot; billed per generated second, so rejected takes cost money.

e1_hero_premium_share.label: E1 share of hero generated seconds billed at the premium (Pro high-res) tier
e1_hero_premium_share.rationale: Hero footage needs the highest resolution and fidelity.

e1_adapted_gen_share.label: E1 share of adapted videos (cut-downs, formats, languages, segment variants) with generated inserts or b-roll
e1_adapted_gen_share.rationale: Most adaptations are re-cuts of approved footage; generated inserts are used where a new scene, setting or segment cue is needed.

e1_adapted_gen_seconds.label: E1 kept generated seconds per adapted video that uses the lever
e1_adapted_gen_seconds.rationale: A 6 s insert or b-roll segment inside a 15-30 s adaptation.

e1_adapted_takes.label: E1 generated takes per accepted second (adapted)
e1_adapted_takes.rationale: Short inserts converge faster than hero shots.

e1_adapted_premium_share.label: E1 share of adapted generated seconds billed at the premium tier
e1_adapted_premium_share.rationale: Standard tier is enough for social-first inserts.

e1_mb_per_second.label: E1 stored size per kept generated second

e1_cs_frames_per_second.label: E1 frames per kept second analysed by Content Safety image analysis
e1_cs_frames_per_second.rationale: Microsoft Learn: Azure AI Content Safety has no direct video moderation API - extract frames at regular intervals (for example every 1-2 seconds) and analyse each with the image API. Base = one frame per kept second (conservative).

e1_transcode_vcpu_s_per_s.label: E1 conform / transcode compute per kept generated second
e1_transcode_vcpu_s_per_s.rationale: Conform generated clips to the timeline, loudness and captions on Container Apps jobs.

e1_displaced_share_hero.label: E1 share of a hero spot's residual external cost that generated footage replaces when used
e1_displaced_share_hero.rationale: Residual = what the compositor does not already displace (shoots, stock, 3D/VFX, pick-ups); generated footage replaces stock, animatics, VFX and pick-up shots, not the live shoot.

e1_displaced_share_adapted.label: E1 share of an adapted video's residual external cost that generated inserts replace when used
e1_displaced_share_adapted.rationale: Residual = the 20 % of adapted-video cost the compositor does not displace (new scenes, stock, reshoots).

e1_review_min_hero.label: E1 extra creative / legal / likeness review per hero master using generated footage
e1_review_min_hero.rationale: Artefact, likeness, protected-material and disclosure checks on generated footage by creative and legal reviewers.

e1_review_min_adapted.label: E1 extra review per adapted video using generated inserts
e1_review_min_adapted.rationale: Short inserts reviewed alongside the adaptation.

e1_integration_usd.label: E1 one-time integration (VideoProvider adapter, evaluation set, provenance and disclosure hooks, prompt library)
e1_integration_usd.rationale: Partner / SI effort; phased by exp_integration_share_y1 (30 % in Year 1, 70 % in Year 2) when the lever is on.

e1_run_pct.label: E1 annual run and support cost as a share of the integration cost
e1_run_pct.rationale: Same convention as the core integration run cost.

confidence_e1.label: E1 benefit confidence factor
confidence_e1.rationale: Generative-video quality, availability and policy are still moving: half of the modelled displacement is credited.

e2_skus.label: E2 active SKUs that need product-page content
e2_skus.rationale: Contoso-style global CPG / retail group; validate against the PIM.

e2_market_presence.label: E2 share of markets in which an SKU is listed
e2_market_presence.rationale: Listings = SKUs x markets x presence; not every SKU is sold everywhere.

e2_images_per_listing.label: E2 images per SKU listing (hero, lifestyle scenes, infographics, pack views)
e2_images_per_listing.rationale: Typical product-page image sets run from 5 to 12 images.

e2_refresh_share.label: E2 share of listing images created or refreshed each year
e2_refresh_share.rationale: New SKUs, seasonal and retailer-spec refreshes.

e2_attempt_factor.label: E2 generated candidates per accepted image
e2_attempt_factor.rationale: Rejected candidates are billed; the core studio uses 1.6 for adapted video stills.

e2_high_quality_share.label: E2 share of candidates generated at high quality (1536 px)
e2_high_quality_share.rationale: Hero images at high quality, the rest at medium quality.

e2_desc_in_k.label: E2 input tokens per localized product description
e2_desc_in_k.rationale: Product data, claims library excerpt and market rules.

e2_desc_out_k.label: E2 output tokens per localized product description

e2_alt_in_k.label: E2 input tokens per image alt-text
e2_alt_in_k.rationale: Vision input is billed as image tokens inside this figure.

e2_alt_out_k.label: E2 output tokens per image alt-text

e2_guardian_scale.label: E2 Guardian check weight per listing (claims, nutrition and legal text, pack accuracy)
e2_guardian_scale.rationale: Relative to one full Guardian pass on a campaign version.

e2_mb_per_image.label: E2 size of one image rendition

e2_renditions_per_image.label: E2 stored renditions per kept image (retailer and PIM specs)

e2_pulls_per_image.label: E2 syndication downloads per kept image per year
e2_pulls_per_image.rationale: Retailer, PIM, DAM and CDN pulls, delivered through Front Door.

e2_search_units_per_million_images.label: E2 extra AI Search units per million indexed images (vectors + metadata)
e2_search_units_per_million_images.rationale: A 1,536-dimension vector is about 6 KB; one search unit holds on the order of a million indexed assets with metadata.

e2_baseline_cost_per_image_usd.label: E2 blended cost of a product image today (photography, retouching, localisation of overlays)
e2_baseline_cost_per_image_usd.rationale: Blend of net-new lifestyle shots (tens of dollars) and cheap adaptations (a few dollars); validate against agency and studio rate cards.

e2_displaced_share.label: E2 share of that cost the studio displaces
e2_displaced_share.rationale: Hero and regulated imagery stays with photographers.

e2_online_revenue_share.label: E2 share of revenue sold online where product-page content matters
e2_online_revenue_share.rationale: Own D2C plus retailer.com sales of a global CPG / retail group; validate with e-commerce data.

e2_conversion_uplift_pct.label: E2 relative uplift on that revenue from richer, localized product pages (FLAGGED conversion / return-rate effect)
e2_conversion_uplift_pct.rationale: No verified source: shown separately and credited at a 25 % confidence factor; treat as upside until measured in a holdout.

e2_integration_usd.label: E2 one-time integration (PIM / e-commerce connectors, retailer specs, approvals)
e2_integration_usd.rationale: Partner / SI effort; phased by exp_integration_share_y1 (30 % in Year 1, 70 % in Year 2) when the lever is on.

e2_run_pct.label: E2 annual run and support cost as a share of the integration cost

e2_review_sample_rate.label: E2 share of generated images sampled for human review
e2_review_sample_rate.rationale: Guardian checks every image automatically; people sample and review exceptions.

e2_review_min_per_image.label: E2 review minutes per sampled image

confidence_e2.label: E2 confidence factor on avoided photography and retouching cost
confidence_e2.rationale: Concrete, auditable spend, but image acceptance by retailers and brands is unproven.

confidence_e2_conversion.label: E2 confidence factor on the conversion / return-rate effect

e3_multiplier.label: E3 segment variants generated per approved campaign version at full scale
e3_multiplier.rationale: Pre-generated audience-segment variants: 5-20x more versions per campaign.

e3_mix_static.label: E3 mix of personalised versions: static and social images
e3_mix_static.rationale: The three mix shares sum to 1.0.

e3_mix_copy.label: E3 mix of personalised versions: copy, CRM and email

e3_mix_adapted_video.label: E3 mix of personalised versions: adapted video re-cuts

e3_consumption_factor.label: E3 Azure consumption per personalised version relative to a core adapted version
e3_consumption_factor.rationale: Segment variants are assembled from approved components: no strategy or script pass, but a full Guardian check and rendering.

e3_cosmos_max_ru_s.label: E3 extra Cosmos DB autoscale RU/s at full scale (segment and version metadata)
e3_cosmos_max_ru_s.rationale: Millions of version and segment records plus delivery lookups.

e3_search_units.label: E3 extra AI Search units at full scale
e3_search_units.rationale: Index of personalised versions for reuse and audit.

e3_fabric_cu.label: E3 extra Fabric capacity units at full scale (segment-level performance analytics)
e3_fabric_cu.rationale: Performance by segment x creative x market.

e3_roas_uplift_pct.label: E3 incremental ROAS uplift from audience-level fit on in-scope media
e3_roas_uplift_pct.rationale: On top of the 5 % creative-testing uplift. McKinsey reports that personalization most often drives a 10-15 % revenue lift (company-specific 5-25 %) across end-to-end programmes; only 2 % is credited on in-scope paid media, at a 45 % confidence factor.

e3_review_sample_rate.label: E3 share of personalised versions sampled for human review
e3_review_sample_rate.rationale: Segment rules and templates are approved once per campaign; versions are checked by the Guardian and sampled.

e3_review_min_per_version.label: E3 review minutes per sampled personalised version

e3_integration_usd.label: E3 one-time integration (audience / consent data, segment rules, approval framework)
e3_integration_usd.rationale: Partner / SI effort; phased by exp_integration_share_y1 (30 % in Year 1, 70 % in Year 2) when the lever is on.

e3_run_pct.label: E3 annual run and support cost as a share of the integration cost

confidence_e3.label: E3 benefit confidence factor
confidence_e3.rationale: Segment-level lift must be proven in holdout tests per audience.

e4_fabric_cu.label: E4 Fabric capacity units at full scale (F128 = 128)
e4_fabric_cu.rationale: Performance, CRM / CDP and measurement workloads for a US$8 B group; billed pay-as-you-go for the share of hours in fabric_hours_share.

e4_onelake_tb.label: E4 OneLake data at full scale
e4_onelake_tb.rationale: Ad-platform logs, CRM / CDP extracts and measurement models.

e4_purview_cu.label: E4 extra Purview data-map capacity units at full scale

e4_log_gb_month.label: E4 extra Log Analytics ingestion at full scale

e4_scope_increase_pct.label: E4 extra share of paid media brought into measured, closed-loop optimisation
e4_scope_increase_pct.rationale: Today 35 % of paid media is in scope of creative testing; CRM / CDP and clean-room measurement extend it to about 55 %. The benefit reuses the core ROAS-uplift and media-waste mechanism on the extra media.

e4_integration_usd.label: E4 one-time integration (CRM / CDP connectors, identity resolution, clean-room set-up, semantic model)
e4_integration_usd.rationale: Partner / SI effort; phased by exp_integration_share_y1 (30 % in Year 1, 70 % in Year 2) when the lever is on.

e4_run_pct.label: E4 annual run and support cost as a share of the integration cost
e4_run_pct.rationale: Data platforms need more upkeep than the creative lanes.

e4_ops_usd_per_year.label: E4 data engineering and analytics operations at full scale
e4_ops_usd_per_year.rationale: About 1.5 FTE of data / analytics engineering.

confidence_e4.label: E4 benefit confidence factor
confidence_e4.rationale: Measurement benefits depend on data quality and on the customer acting on the insights.

pilot.label: Pilot footprint (shared sandbox, one environment)
pilot.rationale: Minimum viable production-like stack for one brand; CSV performance data and in-app analytics, no Fabric.

one_brand.label: One-brand footprint
one_brand.rationale: Two AI Search replicas, Basic v2 API gateway, small Fabric capacity, one non-prod environment, no DR region.

global_portfolio.label: Global-portfolio footprint
global_portfolio.rationale: S1 search with 3 replicas x 2 partitions, multi-region Cosmos DB, Front Door Premium + WAF, Standard v2 API Management, Service Bus Premium, Purview, Private Link, non-prod at 35 % and a warm DR region at 25 % of fixed cost.

agency_network.label: Agency-network footprint (multi-tenant)
agency_network.rationale: S2 search, Premium v2 API Management, F64-class analytics and tenant isolation for about 30 client brands.

enterprise_scale.label: Enterprise-scale footprint (catalog + generative video + personalization)
enterprise_scale.rationale: Between the global-portfolio and agency-network footprints: S2 search (4 units), 20,000 RU/s multi-region Cosmos DB, 14 app replicas, three Standard v2 API Management units, Service Bus Premium and a larger log / security estate; the expansion-lever capacity (Fabric, Search, OneLake) is added separately per lever.

pilot.label: Pilot (one brand, 3 markets)
pilot.description: Proof of value on one brand: brief-to-broadcast for 2-3 campaigns with holdout testing.

one_brand.label: One brand (6 markets)
one_brand.description: A full brand team in production use with Guardian, rights and approvals.

global_portfolio.label: Global portfolio (12 markets) - reference customer
global_portfolio.description: Contoso Consumer Brands at full adoption: multi-brand, 12 markets, 50,000 versions a year.

agency_network.label: Agency network (multi-tenant, ~30 client brands)
agency_network.description: A holding company or agency network running client brands in isolated tenants on one platform.

enterprise_scale.label: Enterprise scale (catalog + generative video + personalization)
enterprise_scale.description: A larger global consumer group or retailer (several times the reference customer) with a large catalog: 150,000 approved versions a year, 20 markets, 1,000 users, 40,000 SKUs, personalised variants at 10x, generative video on part of the hero and adapted spots, and a marketing data and clean-room platform on Fabric. Expansion levers E1-E4 are all at full scale.
enterprise_scale.rationale: Assumption-driven profile: three times the reference customer's approved versions (150,000), 20 markets (the agency-network tier uses the same), 1,000 users, a 40,000-SKU catalog at 35 % market presence, 10 segment variants per version, Fabric F256 and 400 TB of OneLake data. Validate every figure per customer.

sensitivity_drivers.label: Share of baseline cost Studio can displace
Paid media in scope of testing
Expansion levers E1-E4 (off to full scale)

meta.model_basis: Models are priced at Global Standard; the base scenario adds ai_price_uplift_pct (EU Data Zone = +10 %). Units are normalised to the unit named in each item's 'unit' field using 'factor'.

e1.description: Generative video through the pluggable VideoProvider (Azure OpenAI video models where deployable in the customer's region, or partner video models from the Foundry catalog): generated footage for hero masters and adapted videos, billed per generated second, behind the same Guardian, provenance and approval gates. The demo ships the ffmpeg compositor.

e2.description: Catalog-scale product content: product-page images, lifestyle scenes, alt-text and localized descriptions for SKUs x markets x images, fed by PIM / e-commerce connectors and checked by the Guardian.

e3.description: Audience-level personalization: pre-generated segment variants (5-20x more versions per campaign) managed by the variant engine and measured by segment.

e4.description: Marketing data and clean-room platform on Microsoft Fabric: performance data plus CRM / CDP, measurement models and clean-room collaboration, beyond the minimal data pull-through already in the core model.

video_price_reference.availability: Azure OpenAI Sora 2 (preview on Microsoft Learn); region availability varies; sora-2 deprecated in swedencentral as of Nov 2026
Foundry catalog partner model; verify availability, terms and ACR eligibility

notes: Base and Conservative keep every lever off, so their numbers are the Release-1 campaign studio only; Upside switches all four on at full scale. The 'full_expansion_case' block shows any scenario with E1-E4 at full scale.

Honest reading: generated video and catalog images are cheap per unit at list price (cents per image, dollars per kept second), so E1 and E2 add little Azure consumption at this customer's volumes even though their customer benefit is large; the consumption that makes ACR material comes from the data platform (E4), segment-scale personalization (E3), and from customer breadth and users (the enterprise-scale tier).

Video is billed per generated second, including rejected takes, so cost per kept second equals list price x takes. Sora 2 is a preview model on Microsoft Learn and is deprecated in swedencentral as of Nov 2026: the VideoProvider plug-in keeps the product independent of any single video model.

Partner video models ('Azure Fal' meters, effective 2026-11-01) are listed in the Retail Prices API at about US$0.03-0.30 per second; they are shown as a price reference only. Confirm availability, terms and ACR eligibility with Microsoft before relying on them.
